intro: A command-line tool for spoken-word audio applies silence and filler-word removal, pause shortening, and voice-fitted equalization to reach a target loudness. The work sits in podcast post-production and audio processing.

projects.name: Podcast Light Edit Chain
projects.description: One-command light edit for spoken-word recordings: cut ums with the Uhm frame classifier (no ASR), shorten long pauses, voice-fitted EQ, -16 LUFS. With a measured demo.
